An independent results archive. This page is not produced by the Kansas City Parochial League. Results come from the league's official DirectAthletics meet reports, 2017 to present; the all-time records are as published by the PLKC.

School names are spelled many ways in the reports and were merged (for example “PRESENTATIO”, “OLP” and “Our Lady of the” are all Our Lady of the Presentation). Runners are matched across seasons by name, school and grade. Border War results include Kansas CYO schools.
